title: PR Story
description: A standard file describing a pull request as an ordered sequence of storytelling steps for review.

version.description: Format version. Currently only 1 is supported.

title.description: Human readable title for the whole pull request story.

base.description: Git ref/commit-ish the PR is diffed against (e.g. main, origin/main, a commit sha). Required: this is what lets `prstory tell` run with no flags - the story carries its own base, it isn't passed on the command line.

head.description: Git ref/commit-ish for the tip of the PR branch. Defaults to HEAD, which is almost always correct.

name.description: Title of the step, e.g. 'Redefine the storage interface'.

description.description: Why this step exists: the reasoning or objective behind the change, in markdown.

files.description: Paths (relative to repo root) touched by this step.

story.description: Ordered narrative for the step: interleaved prose and diff references.

ref.description: Reference to a file, or a line range within it, e.g. 'src/foo.py' or 'src/foo.py#L10-L20'. Never a copy of the diff: the CLI resolves this against the base/head refs at render time using the git CLI.

caption.description: Optional short caption/annotation shown above the resolved diff.
